members.name: FERN
members.role: Prairie habitat surveyor; patient setups and small openings.

MnLeagueRoom1BeforeText: FERN: First League match? Look at your partner a second. Let them see you're ready before you worry about me.
MnLeagueRoom1WonText: FERN: I was waiting for a clear opening and you took a little one. I'll remember that.
MnLeagueRoom1LostText: FERN: Take a second. Your partner can hear you. Get them warm at the clinic before you decide whether to try again.
MnLeagueRoom1AfterText: FERN: FLINT's through there. He'll call you in even if you're already in the room.
MnLeagueRoom1NoRunText: FERN: Start at the lobby desk. Once the registrar has your name, she'll send you straight to me.
MnLeagueRoom1RematchText: FERN: Hello, CHAMPION. I usually wait and see what a challenger gives me. You can wait for me this time.

members.name: FLINT
members.role: Retired underground maintenance worker; deliberate, durable battling.

MnLeagueRoom2BeforeText: FLINT: COME IN! Oh. You're right here. I used to call over the fans down the mine. Old habit. We'll see if I can keep it down once we start.
MnLeagueRoom2WonText: FLINT: Come back, pal. I was yelling the same thing louder while you were already trying to turn. I saw it too late.
MnLeagueRoom2LostText: FLINT: Easy, pal. Let them call their partner back. Sorry, trainer. I forget how loud it gets in here when you're trying to think.
MnLeagueRoom2AfterText: FLINT: VEIL's next. I used to holler through the door to let her know somebody was coming. She told me she could hear the latch just fine.
MnLeagueRoom2NoRunText: FLINT: FERN goes first. If you've been out of the League since you beat her, sign in at the lobby desk and start with her again.
MnLeagueRoom2RematchText: FLINT: Come in. Heard me? Good. My partner's been looking at me funny all week. I stopped hollering every time he did what I asked.

members.name: VEIL
members.role: Night search volunteer; observant, restrained and difficult to read.

MnLeagueRoom3BeforeText: VEIL: On night searches, my partner hears people before I do. When she stops, I stop. She's stopped for you now.
MnLeagueRoom3WonText: VEIL: It's over, love. Come here. You can stay out a minute. Trainer, go on. We'll catch our breath.
MnLeagueRoom3LostText: VEIL: It's all right. Give them a moment. When my partner loses a match, I let her hear my voice before I reach for her BALL.
MnLeagueRoom3AfterText: VEIL: HALDEN's through the next door. He likes to give people a minute before the match. Take it if you need it.
MnLeagueRoom3NoRunText: VEIL: I'm third. You'll need to beat FERN and FLINT after your latest sign-in. The desk is downstairs if you need to start over.
MnLeagueRoom3RematchText: VEIL: Let the door click behind you. She likes to hear where everybody is before she starts. There. Hello again.

members.name: HALDEN
members.role: Canoe guide; reads momentum and commits when the current turns.

MnLeagueRoom4BeforeText: HALDEN: Three matches in a row. My hands used to shake by the time I got to this door. Did yours start yet? I'll wait.
MnLeagueRoom4WonText: HALDEN: You changed course and I kept leaning into the old turn. Good match. Give me a second to catch up.
MnLeagueRoom4LostText: HALDEN: Call it there. My partner could use a rest too. The clinic's in town. If you decide to come back, sign in at the desk and start with FERN.
MnLeagueRoom4AfterText: HALDEN: That's four. CASEY's through there. Pick up your bag. Nearly left mine here my first time.
MnLeagueRoom4NoRunText: HALDEN: FERN, FLINT, then VEIL. Those three wins have to be on this run. If you've been out, start again at the desk.
MnLeagueRoom4RematchText: HALDEN: I thought through our match in the canoe and ran into the reeds. This time I'll watch where you're actually going.

members.name: CASEY
members.role: Champion who separates public duty from sporting proof; direct, competitive and generous in defeat.

MnLeagueChampionBeforeText: CASEY: My first challenger dropped their BALL. I bent to pick it up and dropped mine too. We both felt better after that. Take your time. I'm ready when you are.
MnLeagueChampionWonText: CASEY: Come here, girl. You did fine. Well played, trainer. Go on through the north door with your team. I'll stay here with mine a minute.
MnLeagueChampionLostText: CASEY: Come back, girl. Trainer, you gave us a good fight. Take your team to the clinic in town. If you come back for me, I'll be here.
MnLeagueChampionAfterText: CASEY: The recorder's through the north door. They write down everyone you brought, even the ones who sat this match out.
MnLeagueChampionNoRunText: CASEY: Four wins between the desk and this door. If you left partway through, the registrar can start you again.
MnLeagueChampionRematchText: CASEY: I wondered if you'd come back once your name was in the book. I'm glad you did. I've been thinking about how I'd open this time.

MnElyRegistrationText: REGISTRAR: Shall I put your name down? You'll start with FERN. Beat all four to face CASEY. If you lose or leave, come back here to start a new run.
MnElyBadgeDeniedText: REGISTRAR: Let me count. The League takes eight BADGES. If you've only come in to warm up, the clinic's across town.
MnElySurveyDeniedText: REGISTRAR: You've got all eight. I'd sign you in, but we're still waiting on word from the intake. If you've come to help, the survey shelter's north of town. Ask for IVY on the radio there.
MnElyRegistrationDeclinedText: REGISTRAR: Sure. The clinic's open if your team needs a rest. Come back when you're ready.

MnElyRecordText: RECORDER: Come round to this side. I leave the book open while the team is here so everybody can see their name go in.
RECORDER: Yours first. Then tell me who came with you.
MnElyRecordDeniedText: RECORDER: I'll put your team in the book once you beat all five on one run. If you need to sign in, the registrar's downstairs.
